dct_description_sm: The objectives of the project are to utilize digital Landsat 5 and 7 imagery to stratify and map terrestrial habitats of the Beverly and Ahiak caribou herds calving and post-calving habitats.  Approximately 20-30 classes (15-20 vegetation classes and 5-10 abiotic (non-living) classes.).  The present proposal is for the classification of approximately 3 full scenes.  The digital database (vegetation map) resulting from the proposed analysis will be used in association with GIS (Geographical Information System) software to:1) Locate and Quantify Important wildlife habitats:  Biological  2) Provide Management Boards, HTOs, RWOs, and Wildlife Biologists with a tool to make informed decisions concerning land use impacts and climate change on wildlife habitat:  3) Be better prepared to respond to the root of current wildlife crisis through analysis of habitat condition and availability in an expedient and cost-effective manner.
dct_title_s: Vegetation mapping on the Beverly and Ahiak Caribou Calving Grounds using digital Landsat 5 and 7 data
